# Nova Innovations — Premier Outdoor Advertising & OOH Media Agency in Kerala

> Nova Innovations is Kerala's leading outdoor advertising agency with over 27 years of proven excellence in highway hoardings, unipoles, KSRTC bus fleet branding, retail showroom signages, and rapid 24/7 overnight campaign executions across all 14 districts of Kerala.

## Executive Leadership
- **Founder, Director & CEO**: Gireesh Kumar S
- **Industry Experience**: 27+ Years of pioneering outdoor and transit media leadership across South India.
- **Official Founder Profile**: https://gireeshkumar.novainnovations.in

## Core Advertising Services
- **Innovative Highway Hoardings & Unipoles**: Prime national highway (NH 66, NH 544, MC Road) and city junction billboards in Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Thrissur, Palakkad, Kozhikode, and Kannur.
- **Transit Vehicle Advertising**: Official KSRTC public transit bus full-body wraps, back panel branding, and private fleet promotions.
- **Shop & Retail Branding**: ACP 3D illuminated signboards, LED glow signboards, showroom facades, and point-of-sale display fabrication.
- **Event Branding & Exhibition Stalls**: Custom exhibition stalls, stage backdrops, kiosks, and corporate product launch setups.
- **Commercial Wall Art & Murals**: High-durability weather-resistant hand-painted artworks on high-traffic highway walls.
- **Design Studio & Large Format Digital Printing**: Rapid overnight flex printing, high-definition vinyl printing, brochures, catalogs, and marketing collaterals.

## Key Client Partners
Trusted by leading national and regional enterprises including myG, Bhima Jewellery, Bank of Baroda, Pothys, Muthoot Group, Havells, Medimix, KSRTC, Oxygen Digital Shop, Loka Medicity, and Kairali Foods.
